_comment: Deliberate, reviewed differences between the baseline and a migration target. Anything not listed here fails the suite. Each entry is a decision a human made, not a way to silence a failure; give a reason.

entries.reason: Comments are intentionally dropped from the static export.
A static archive has no unpublished pages; a missing page is as private as a 403. Applies only when MIGRATION_TARGET=static.
The search block (a form) was removed because it cannot work on a static site; this is its heading. `equals` matches the whole line, so no other line is hidden.
Static export has no breadcrumb trail.
